text:
maria: Heads-up — onboarding run for magnet-16k-q8 showed a KV-cache stitch failure only after long prefill + continued streaming. Reproducer below, short logs attached.

aj: Ack. Can you paste the tiny log snippet where it fails?

maria: Sure, here's the minimal tail (prefill=12k, seed=42):
```
[2026-03-22T18:12:04Z] PREFILL: wrote 12000 tokens to KV
[2026-03-22T18:12:07Z] KV_CHECK: idx 11998 expected 0x1a2b got 0x1a3b
[2026-03-22T18:12:07Z] GENERATION: diverged at token_index=12123 (first mismatch)
[2026-03-22T18:12:07Z] CONTEXT: model.max_pos=16384, prefill=12000, inflight_seq=1300
```
Pretty consistent across 3 runs. If prefill <= 8k it's clean.

oliver: Hmm. Sounds like a phase drift at the rotary scale boundary when we cross ~prefill + inflight ~= 13k. Could be RoPE rescale math interacting badly with quantized kernels. Did you try forcing the old float16 rope routine?

maria: Not yet. I pinned kernel=1.25. Try flagging `--force-rope-rescale=linear` next.

ajen: Also try running with prefix-cache-flush-on-prefill=true to see if it's a stale-kv hysteresis vs true indexing wrap. I remember a similar ghost-token when warmhead remained.

maria: Running both now. Reproducer command I'm using: 
```
python tools/repro_prefill.py --model magnet-16k-q8 --seed 42 --prefill 12000 --streaming=false --log-level=debug
```
Will attach full logs in a minute.

jen: Note for triage: if forcing the fp16 rope fixes it, that strongly implicates the quant-scaled rescale path. We should also compare rotary phase values pre/post quant step to see monotonicity.

bench-bot: quick bench summary (run id f3a2): model=magnet-16k-q8, prefill=12000, kernel=1.25, throughput=11.9 toks/s, token_mismatch_rate=1.9% after token 12000, reproducible=3/3. Reproducer link: https://bench/rep/f3a2

oliver: If mismatch persists with fp16 rope, try bisecting kernels between 1.22..1.26. Also compare pos-embedding lookup vs rotary-derived phase on an identical seed pre/post quant. A small inspection script can diff the floats and hash them.

aj: I'll spin up a small job to dump the per-token rotary phase floats before quant and after quant for the same input length. If we see non-linear kinks at high positions that's our culprit.

maria: Update — forcing rescales to linear removed the mismatch on 2/2 runs. So hypothesis strengthened: quantized kernel's rescale path uses a different clipping/scale causing phase compress/expand near high indices (hysteresis when stitching prefill + inflight).

jen: Great find. Next steps: 1) open a regression issue with kernel team, include the minimal repro and rotary-diff dump. 2) short-term: enable a safe guard in the onboarding harness to force fp16 rope for any prefill > 8k on q8 models. 3) long-term: add a numeric unit test comparing rotary phases across quant paths.

maria: I'll file the GH issue and push the repro + rotary dump. Ticket draft: "quant-rescale: rotary phase drift for long-prefill -> KV stitching mismatch (magnet-16k-q8)".

aj: I'll take the unit test. Will also run a small param sweep (prefill 6k..14k) to capture hysteresis threshold.

maria: Thanks all — posting full logs to the triage thread and will update the ticket when done. :thumbsup:
